name: Mass Heal
summary: Restores up to 700 Hit Points divided among creatures you can see and cures conditions.

stats.effect: A flood of healing energy flows from you into creatures around you. You restore up to 700 {ref:glossary/hit-points}, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell also have the {ref:condition/blinded}, {ref:condition/deafened}, and {ref:condition/poisoned} conditions removed from them.
